Retain a consistent DEPTH AI logo, slender app header and narrow left navigation across the whole storyboard. Replace all reference screen CONTENT with the specific screen requested below. Product behavior: the workspace normally shows independent functional modules in organized summarized spatial groups. A permanent BEHAVIOR PREVIEW shows reconstructed or captured screens and illustrative before/after states, NOT a continuously running program. A user picks an element or an action in this preview; relevant references travel forward and assemble inside one large feature envelope beside it. Selecting modules reveals compact inline properties, source or concise AI rationale. Shared implementations retain one identity. The source project space stays in context, while thousands of modules remain folded into meaningful groups rather than tiny spaghetti nodes.

CRITICAL PREVIEW SEMANTICS: Use short labels such as "Behavior preview", "Captured view", "Illustrated state", "Next step", "Before", "After", "Source mapped", "AI inferred", "Not observed", "Proposed". The preview can explain navigation, data updates, validation and branching, not only scene transitions. Source-confirmed, inferred and unresolved relationships must be visually distinguishable where relevant. Use solid, dashed, or faded connectors and a small understandable legend, not a giant technical disclaimer.

Readable small module representations are role-specific: UI controls show their actual miniature appearance, data modules show useful values, logic modules show a short role and optional source snippet, font is only a small Aa tile and short name, images/assets are actual thumbnails. Do not show hidden chain of thought. Existing CLI remains a normal small terminal when requested, never a replacement chatbot. Text must be short and accurate, mostly concise English UI labels. No decorative machine/city/planet metaphor, no physical desk/laptop mockup, no people outside any necessary target content. All 3D forms represent software grouping and reference structure, not hardware.

Create one complete, carefully composed screenshot, no collage of alternatives, no giant presentation title, no watermark. This is a design concept, not evidence that features are already implemented.
